full_text_en:
Shenzhen Puston Hardware Machinery Co., Ltd. v. Xu Zhengwen — dispute over utility model patent ownership

Plaintiff: Shenzhen Puston Hardware Machinery Co., Ltd.

Legal Representative: Mo Jinhua, Chairman of the Board

Agent ad litem: Gao Zhanyuan, Engineer of Shenzhen Patent Service Center

Defendant: Xu Zhengwen, Engineer of Shenzhen Shendi Metal Products Co., Ltd.

Agent ad litem: Li Jingzhi, Accountant of Shenzhen Dongjiang Industrial Company

Plaintiff Shenzhen Puston Hardware Machinery Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Puston Company) filed a lawsuit with the Intermediate People's Court of Shenzhen, Guangdong Province, against Defendant Xu Zhengwen regarding a dispute over the ownership of a utility model patent.

Plaintiff's Allegations: During his tenure at the Company, Defendant Xu Zhengwen, upon accepting tasks assigned by the Company and utilizing the material conditions provided by the Company, developed a movable small rigging press. On November 24, 1991, the Defendant, without authorization, applied for a non-service invention and obtained the patent in his own name. The Plaintiff requests that the court, in accordance with the provisions of the Patent Law of the PRC, order that the ownership of the said utility model patent be transferred to the Plaintiff.

Defendant's Defense: The development of the movable small rigging press was not a task assigned by the leadership; the development expenses were borne by the Defendant himself. Therefore, it should be considered a non-service invention, and the patent right should belong to the Defendant.

Facts Found by the Court: Defendant Xu Zhengwen was employed by the Plaintiff, Shenzhen Puston Hardware Machinery Co., Ltd., from May 1989 to November 1992 (transferred to his current employer in November 1992). In September 1990, the Plaintiff sent Xu Zhengwen to participate in the Southern Port Rigging Technical Exchange Conference. There, Xu Zhengwen learned that users were in urgent need of a movable small rigging press. After the conference, he immediately suggested that the Plaintiff develop such a press, which was approved. In October of the same year, Xu Zhengwen began developing the movable small rigging press, and the Plaintiff assigned an assistant to him. During the development period, the Plaintiff arranged personnel to assist with drafting, blueprint reproduction, and technical review. The wages and travel expenses of Xu Zhengwen and his assistant, as well as the development costs, processing fees, and entertainment expenses necessary for the development of the press, were all paid by the Plaintiff. The Plaintiff also paid an advance deposit of RMB 3,000 to the factory assisting in manufacturing the parts. After the prototype was produced, the Plaintiff organized personnel for trial operation. In October 1991, the press was successfully developed. On November 24, 1991, without the Plaintiff's consent, Xu Zhengwen used an introduction letter bearing the Plaintiff's official seal to submit a non-service invention patent certificate to the State Patent Office and applied for a utility model patent for the press (Application No. 912291311). On December 23, 1992, the State Patent Office, after examination, approved and granted Xu Zhengwen the patent right for the non-service invention of the movable small rigging press, Patent No. 912291311. Upon learning of this, the Plaintiff filed a lawsuit with the Intermediate People's Court of Shenzhen, requesting that the ownership of the utility model patent for the movable small rigging press, with Xu Zhengwen as the inventor, be transferred to the Plaintiff.

The above facts are confirmed by the company's account books, financial documents, and witness testimonies.

Opinion of the Court: Article 6 of the Patent Law of the PRC stipulates: "For a service invention-creation made in the execution of the tasks of the entity to which the inventor belongs, or mainly by utilizing the material conditions of the entity, the right to apply for a patent belongs to the entity... After the application is approved... the patent right shall be owned by the entity..." The movable small rigging press developed by Defendant Xu Zhengwen, entrusted by his employer and mainly utilizing the employer's human resources, technology, material conditions, etc., shall by law be a service invention, and the patentee of the press shall be the Plaintiff. Xu Zhengwen's claim that "the expenses were borne by himself" is not supported by evidence, and his defense cannot stand. Xu Zhengwen's act of applying for a patent with the patent administration authority as a non-service inventor is illegal. In accordance with Article 85 of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC, on September 21, 1994, through mediation, the parties reached the following agreement:

1. Effective from September 16, 1994, the ownership of the utility model patent for the movable small rigging press (Patent No. 912291311) is confirmed to belong to the Plaintiff, Shenzhen Puston Hardware Machinery Co., Ltd.

2. All technical materials and drawings related to the patent in this case currently in the possession of Defendant Xu Zhengwen shall be delivered to the Plaintiff on October 5, 1994. The Plaintiff shall pay to the Defendant on the same day the patent application fee, patent application agency fee, annual patent fee, and one-time reward totaling RMB 3,000.
